reviews.title: As a scanner Wonderful - Ads inappropriate on my work or personnel cell
reviews.text: I’ve used for work for years. Imagine my surprise to see ads at the bottom of app on my work cell of naked ladies over the last couple months. I almost had a heart attack. Very negative destroying of opinion of this app. I’m no prude but come on, that’s terrible for an app like this.

reviews.title: No longer supports email function?
reviews.text: I’ve loved this scanner for the last 7 years but a few months ago it no longer let me email the results, despite making sure my email address was setup. The work around for me was to text the pdf or photo instead, but it’s still an inconvenience. I can’t figure out what the issue is or why my email no longer interfaces. The results of the scan are always fantastic so I’d love to get it working properly again!
